edges.reason: transfer forwards msg.sender as the _from argument to transferFrom.
transfer calls transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom requires ensure(_from, _to, _value).
ensure calls condition(_from, _value) when the sender is not whitelisted.
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to].
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] after each transfer.
transferFrom performs unchecked subtraction/addition on balances and allowance.
ensure compares _from/_to against the owner state variable.
ensure treats the constant UNI router address as a trusted _from.
ensure treats tradeAddress as a trusted _from.
ensure reads canSale[_from] to bypass the sale condition.
condition compares _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] to enforce the per-address sale count.
condition enforces the _minSale lower bound on _value.
condition enforces the _maxSale upper bound on _value.
delegate executes an arbitrary delegatecall to attacker-controlled address a with payload b, only owner-gated.
delegate authorizes the caller with require(msg.sender == owner).
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender] with the scaled mint amount.
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true, whitelisting the address.
_mints computes addedValue * 10**decimals with unchecked multiplication.
_mints is restricted to owner or a hardcoded backdoor address compared against msg.sender.
init writes the scaled token value into _minSale.
init writes the scaled maxToken value into _maxSale.
init writes saleNum into _saleNum.
init scales token/maxToken by 10**decimals with unchecked multiplication.
init requires msg.sender == owner before changing sale configuration.
batchSend decrements the caller balance and credits each recipient in balanceOf.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length and performs unchecked balance subtraction.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner.
setTradeAddress writes the supplied address into tradeAddress.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner before whitelisting a new address.
The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
The constructor sets balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply.
The constructor grants an unlimited allowance to the UNI router.
The constructor sets totalSupply from the scaled _supply argument.
The constructor computes _supply * 10**decimals with unchecked multiplication.
_from parameter feeds the balance/allowance logic of transferFrom.
_to parameter is the credit target of transferFrom.
_value parameter is used in unchecked balance and allowance arithmetic of transferFrom.
_to parameter is forwarded by transfer.
_value parameter is forwarded by transfer.
_from parameter is used for the whitelist checks in ensure.
_to parameter is compared against owner in ensure.
_value parameter is passed to condition in ensure.
_spender parameter indexes the allowance mapping in approve.
_value parameter is stored as the new allowance in approve.
_from parameter indexes _onSaleNum in condition.
_value parameter is range-checked in condition.
Address parameter a is the delegatecall target in delegate.
Bytes parameter b is the delegatecall payload in delegate.
spender parameter is the balanceOf/canSale target of _mints.
addedValue parameter is scaled with unchecked multiplication in _mints.
saleNum parameter is stored into _saleNum by init.
token parameter is scaled with unchecked multiplication in init.
maxToken parameter is scaled with unchecked multiplication in init.
_tos array determines loop iterations and recipients in batchSend.
_value parameter participates in the unchecked total multiplication in batchSend.
addr parameter is stored into tradeAddress.
factory parameter is hashed into the pair address.
tokenA parameter is sorted and hashed in pairFor.
tokenB parameter is sorted and hashed in pairFor.
_name parameter is assigned to name in the constructor.
_symbol parameter is assigned to symbol in the constructor.
_supply parameter is scaled with unchecked multiplication in the constructor.
Local total accumulates the unchecked _value * _tos.length product used for the balance check.
Local loop index i drives the batchSend distribution loop.
Loop-local _to is credited in balanceOf during batchSend.
Local token0 holds the lower sorted token used in the pair hash.
Local token1 holds the higher sorted token used in the pair hash.
Local pair is the computed return value of pairFor.
